repo.description:
### Summary
The `channels.convertToTeam` REST endpoint lets any authenticated user convert an arbitrary public channel they have no relationship to into a team, simply by identifying the channel with `channelName` instead of `channelId` in the request body. The endpoint's own default permission (`create-team`) is granted to every registered user, and the one guard meant to restrict this to the channel's actual owner/moderator/admin (`edit-room`) is only evaluated when `channelId` is supplied.
repo.summary: Broken Access Control in channels.convertToTeam Allows Unauthorized Conversion of Public Channels into Teams
